description: Image Description: The image shows a wired computer mouse resting on a wooden surface with a visible grain pattern. The mouse has a sleek, ergonomic design with a dark gray or black body and a silver or metallic trim along its edges. It features a standard two-button layout with a central scroll wheel. The cable extends from the back of the mouse, leading to a USB connector at the end. The cable is coiled and includes a small black plastic component near the connector, possibly a strain relief or cable
